display_name: Osa-AK battery: orders carried by a means
status: Numbers for simcore/command/battery_orders.hpp (roadmap G10.2-G10.5, docs/campaign/11_BATTERY_LIFE_PROPOSAL.md section 5.5). The R-123M's times are the training text's, as in data/procedures/osa_ak.json; the signals' reach and the times of speech are SAM3D estimates until G0 reads the drill. The runner's pace and the way on foot are signal_means.json's messenger and relay rules.
notes: voenizdat_osa_1991 p240: on the march the battery commander rides at the head in the PU-12M and signals by flags and lamps; radio is forbidden except for fire control. At a position the battery net is the first means, the field telephone where lines are laid, and a runner the last.

set_warm_s.source: r123m_training (switch on, warm the set up for 10 min, then call)
set_warm_s.notes: The same 10 min as the console's r123m_left subsystem (data/procedures/osa_ak.json): a set switched off misses everything said on the net until it is warm.

set_tx_s.source: r123m_training (from Д. ПРИЕМ to СИМПЛЕКС wait 3 min for the transmitter valves)
set_tx_s.notes: After the warm-up: the commander can answer on the net only then (the console's r123m_left_tx).

flags_m.source: SAM3D estimate (a flag signal read by day from one vehicle to the next; the column is 25-50 m apart, 200-800 m with an air attack expected, voenizdat_osa_1991 p232)

lamps_m.source: SAM3D estimate (a hand lamp's signal read at night, blackout driving)

pass_s.source: SAM3D estimate (a vehicle commander seeing a signal and repeating it to the vehicle behind)

say_s.source: SAM3D estimate (a short order, a repeat-back or a report said: «Двадцать первый, к маршу!»)

ring_s.source: SAM3D estimate (a TA-57 on a direct line: wound, rung and answered; utin_2018 table 3.1 gives 1 min for a call through an exchange)

write_s.source: SAM3D estimate (the PU-12M's radiotelephonist writing a report into the journal: the time, the call sign and a few words, pvo_bu_x_1984 art. 24; the same game value as nav::ColumnMarch's)
write_s.notes: An NPC radiotelephonist's; a player keeping the post's journal writes at his own speed (radio_journal.hpp).

chase.source: game value (the giver waits 30 s for a repeat-back, says it twice more, then rings, then sends a runner; simcore/command/orders.hpp ChaseRule) until G0 reads the drill
